messages:
maya: Hey — SLO burn alert just fired for hosted inference in us-east-1, high 5xx+timeout rate over the last 10m. Users reporting timeouts + support tickets piling up. Alert details pasted below from opsbot. Anyone oncall? :eyes:

opsbot: ALERT: SLO_BURN_HIGH (severity=P2)
- service: gateway-hosted-us-east-1
- symptom: 5xx_rate > 2% over 10m (current 3.7%)
- fired_at: 1875001234
- link: https://grafana.redwood/d/alerts/gateway-slo?orgId=1

jordan: I'm oncall. Looking into traces and logs now. Does support have any tenant examples?

maya: Support thread shows 3 different customers in past 15m, all on variably sized payloads. One reproducible example with prompt length ~ 2k tokens. Ticket IDs: S-8821, S-8824.

samir: Querying Prometheus and logs. Early note: the synthetic probe we use for the SLO is hitting /healthz which never touches the model path — that might explain why the probe passed earlier while real traffic got 5xx. Running a path-specific 5xx rate now.

samir: PromQL I used: 
```
sum(rate(http_requests_total{job="gateway",handler=~"/v1/(generate|chat).*",status=~"5..",region="us-east-1"}[5m]))
/ sum(rate(http_requests_total{job="gateway",handler=~"/v1/(generate|chat).*",region="us-east-1"}[5m]))
```
Current result: 5.9% on primary gateway behind lb-gn-3.

elaine: Noted: we rolled out a change 35m ago that lowered idle-request timeout on the inference-proxy from 90s -> 30s to free up sockets. Could be killing long-running model requests and surfacing 504s from the edge.

jordan: Any traces for a failed request?

samir: Traces are sparse — we only have sampling on host-level for long tails. For the two S-8821 failures I found, the edge shows 504 -> ``upstream read timeout``, but the model service didn't emit a KV-cache log for those trace IDs. Possible that requests are being dropped before reaching model workers (gateway-level cancel).

samir: Example log lines (gateway):
```
2026-11-02T13:45:12Z gateway[lb-gn-3] "GET /v1/generate" 504 0ms upstream_read_timeout trace=trc_8f3b
2026-11-02T13:45:13Z gateway[lb-gn-3] "POST /v1/chat" 502 12ms connection_reset trace=trc_8f44
```

elaine: Also saw increased connection queue length on nginx-proxy: backlog spike up to 800 while we have 600 configured. HPA for inference-proxy scaled, but gateway replica count stayed at 2 due to a mis-set annotation (targetCPU=90 in the gateway helm values by mistake). So gateway is the bottleneck.

maya: Summary hypothesis: upstream idle-timeout reduction + gateway under-provisioning + synthetic probe blindspot => real traffic hitting longer model generations get cut mid-stream and edge returns 5xx/504.

jordan: Mitigation options — we should pick 1) quick config bump for gateway timeout/replicas, 2) revert idle-timeout change if risky, 3) add a temporary fallback route to lower-cost model variant. Thoughts?

elaine: I can roll gateway replicas to 6 immediately: `kubectl scale deployment gateway -n prod --replicas=6` and patch nginx timeout: `kubectl patch cm gateway-config -p '{"data":{"proxy_read_timeout":"90s"}}'` then reload. Rolling back idle-timeout change requires a minor release; can do but slower.

samir: I'll update the SLO probe to hit /v1/generate (a lightweight stub route we can add) and change the alert to use that handler-specific 5xx ratio. Quick PR: add probe-path env var to the probe deployment. Also recommend an alert rule change from absolute 5xx_rate to a smoothed rate over both 5m and 30m windows to avoid flaps.

jordan: Do it. I'll execute the immediate scale + timeout patch. Can one of you validate that scaling actually reduces 5xx within 5-10m?

maya: I'll monitor Grafana and open a support triage channel for affected tickets. Also temporarily publicly mark impacted customers via status page.

opsbot: RUNBOOK ACTION: ms-gateway-scale-up initiated by jordan at 1875001500.

devbot: Patch applied: gateway-config.proxy_read_timeout -> 90s by elaine at 1875001522.

samir: After scaling and timeout bump: re-running PromQL — 5xx ratio dropped to 1.1% in last 5m, still elevated but below SLO threshold. Traces still sparse for a subset; sampling config changed to 2x for gateway requests for next 2h to capture failing flows.

jordan: Good. For follow-up:
- create change to synthetic probe to target real endpoints (/v1/generate) and add weighted sampling for long-running requests
- fix helm annotation default (targetCPU) so gateway HPA scales properly
- rollback idle-timeout change or add conditional logic for large payloads
- update runbook with these steps and add a doc for 'probe should target real path'

elaine: I'll file PRs for the HPA/helm fix and the idle-timeout rollback request (release note included).

samir: I'll open an alert PR to add the 30m smoothing and handler-based 5xx rule. Also adding a dashboard panel that compares probe 5xx vs real-path 5xx so we can see divergence.

maya: Support: sending customers a short update and asking for any recent client-side timeouts.

jordan: Closing P2. Will keep monitoring for 2 hours then transition to regular oncall. Good job team. :thumbsup:

devbot: INCIDENT RESOLUTION: actions taken: scaled gateway ->6, increased proxy_read_timeout ->90s, probe update queued, HPA annotation PR opened. Status: degraded -> recovering. Updated at 1875004890.
